lines.zh: 我不走，我一直在原地
lines.en: I do not walk; I am always where I was.

lines.zh: 你看不见我移动，我却换了位置
lines.en: You never see me move, yet I have moved.

lines.zh: 我不需要走过去，门会替我开
lines.en: I need not approach; the door opens for me.

lines.zh: 脚步声？那不是我的
lines.en: Footsteps? Those are not mine.

lines.zh: 我从这一扇门到下一扇门
lines.en: From one door to the next.

lines.zh: 你说我站着没动，那就好
lines.en: You say I have not moved; good.

lines.zh: 慢一点，再慢一点，你才不回头
lines.en: Slower, slower, so you do not look back.

lines.zh: 我的影子和木门重合了
lines.en: My shape has merged with the wooden door.

lines.zh: 我在门后，一直没走远
lines.en: I am behind the door, never far.

lines.zh: 别数我走了几步，数不清的
lines.en: Do not count my steps; they cannot be counted.

lines.zh: 挪动一点点，就够吓人了
lines.en: A tiny shift is all it takes.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只是始终在你前面
lines.en: I do not chase; I am simply always ahead of you.

lines.zh: 我贴着门缝，一动不动
lines.en: I press to the gap in the door, motionless.

lines.zh: 锯子的声音从门后传出来
lines.en: A sawing sound leaks from behind the door.

lines.zh: 我等你把灯关掉
lines.en: I am waiting for you to put the light out.

lines.zh: 门板太薄了，我听得见你的呼吸
lines.en: The door is thin; I can hear you breathe.

lines.zh: 我不急，夜很长
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the night is long.

lines.zh: 木门上有一道缝，够我看你
lines.en: There is a crack in the wood, enough to watch you.

lines.zh: 我数着你在屋里走过几次
lines.en: I count how many times you cross the room.

lines.zh: 你要睡了，我才开始
lines.en: I begin only when you are about to sleep.

lines.zh: 我的手一直按在门上
lines.en: My hand stays pressed to the door.

lines.zh: 屋里越安静，我越清楚
lines.en: The quieter the room, the clearer I am.

lines.zh: 你终于看门这边了
lines.en: You finally look toward the door.

lines.zh: 我从门缝里看你，只有一只眼
lines.en: I watch you through the crack, one eye only.

lines.zh: 你的脸白了，我看得清
lines.en: Your face has gone pale; I can see it.

lines.zh: 别开灯，开了我就在里面
lines.en: Do not turn the light on; then I would be inside.

lines.zh: 我在你身后那扇门上
lines.en: I am on the door behind you.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我不在了
lines.en: When you turn, I am gone.

lines.zh: 我们隔着两指厚的木板
lines.en: Only two fingers of wood between us.

lines.zh: 你听见锯子了吗，那是我在磨牙
lines.en: Hear the sawing? That is me grinding my teeth.

lines.zh: 我歪头，像在认你
lines.en: I tilt my head as if recognizing you.

lines.zh: 你的手离门把太近了
lines.en: Your hand is very close to the handle.

lines.zh: 我隔着门缝咧开嘴，没有声音。
lines.en: I grin through the crack in the door, silent.

lines.zh: 你退了，门就响了一声
lines.en: You step back, and the door creaks.

lines.zh: 我一直看着，从你进屋开始
lines.en: I have been watching since you came in.

lines.zh: 我退到门后，影子小了
lines.en: I withdraw behind the door, my shape smaller.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，可门还在
lines.en: You hit me, but the door remains.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了你就不怕了
lines.en: I do not cry out; a cry would end your fear.

lines.zh: 这一下让我贴得更近
lines.en: That blow only brings me closer.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，像什么都没发生
lines.en: I tilt my head as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 木板在我背后响了一声
lines.en: The wood groans behind me.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，打不动这扇门
lines.en: You can move me, not this door.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，只是半步
lines.en: I retreat half a step, only half.

lines.zh: 伤口里没有血，只有黑
lines.en: No blood in the wound, only black.

lines.zh: 我记住你打了几下
lines.en: I remember how many times you struck.

lines.zh: 你放在门口的东西，我收下了
lines.en: What you left at the door, I have taken.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，但你的害怕有用
lines.en: Food is useless to me; your fear is not.

lines.zh: 你把门打开一条缝，我就够到了
lines.en: Open the door a crack and I can reach it.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只是喜欢看你去拿
lines.en: I do not eat; I just like watching you reach for it.

lines.zh: 我停在离它一步的地方
lines.en: I stop one step from it.

lines.zh: 这东西是你摆的，想引我出来
lines.en: You set this out to draw me. I know.

lines.zh: 我碰了碰，又缩回门后
lines.en: I touch it, then withdraw behind the door.

lines.zh: 你退到门边，我就不碰它。
lines.en: You back away to the door, and I leave it alone.

lines.zh: 我把它拨到地上，让它滚
lines.en: I knock it to the floor and let it roll.

lines.zh: 这点心思，我见得太多了
lines.en: I have seen this trick too many times.

lines.zh: 你撞开我，我却还在原地
lines.en: You push through me, yet I am still here.

lines.zh: 门被你撞得直响，我没退
lines.en: The door rattles, but I do not move.

lines.zh: 我们碰到了，你该冷一下
lines.en: We touched; you should feel cold.

lines.zh: 我不让路，你自己绕
lines.en: I do not step aside; go around.

lines.zh: 这一撞让你离门更近了
lines.en: That shove brought you closer to the door.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴在你背后
lines.en: My shape is pressed against your back.

lines.zh: 你退开时把门带上了
lines.en: You back away and pull the door shut.

lines.zh: 别碰我，碰了会留印
lines.en: Do not touch me; the mark stays.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，只是头转了过来
lines.en: I do not budge; only my head turns.

lines.zh: 我们之间那层木板响了
lines.en: The wood between us groans.

lines.zh: 没有同伴，只有一个我
lines.en: No companion, only one of me.

lines.zh: 我数过，这栋房子里只有你和我
lines.en: I have counted: only you and me in this house.

lines.zh: 你想要人陪，我就来了
lines.en: You wanted company; I came.

lines.zh: 我坐在门这边，你坐那边
lines.en: I sit on this side of the door, you on that.

lines.zh: 不用说话，我听着就行
lines.en: No need to speak; I will listen.

lines.zh: 夜还长，我们慢慢熬
lines.en: The night is long; we will endure it slowly.

lines.zh: 你睡着以后，我会一直看着
lines.en: After you sleep, I will keep watching.

lines.zh: 这栋房子里不需要第三个
lines.en: This house needs no third.

lines.zh: 我是你唯一不会离开的
lines.en: I am the only one who will never leave you.

lines.zh: 别锁门，锁了我还是要进来
lines.en: Do not lock it; locked, I will still come in.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，看了很久
lines.en: I pick it up and look at it a long while.

lines.zh: 东西在我手里变冷了
lines.en: It grows cold in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把它收进门外
lines.en: I take it out beyond the door.

lines.zh: 我拿走的，不会还回来
lines.en: What I take does not come back.

lines.zh: 我挑了一个，剩下的没动
lines.en: I take one and leave the rest.

lines.zh: 它在我指间碎了
lines.en: It crumbles between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我把它放在你床头
lines.en: I set it by your bed.

lines.zh: 拿起来的时候，门响了
lines.en: As I lift it, the door creaks.

lines.zh: 我不需要它，我只是想拿走
lines.en: I do not need it; I only want it gone.

lines.zh: 你数一数，是不是少了一件
lines.en: Count them; is one missing?

lines.zh: 你拿灯照门的时候，我就选了你
lines.en: When you shone the light at the door, I chose you.

lines.zh: 这栋房子里只有你，很好
lines.en: Only you in this house; good.

lines.zh: 我不追，我等你来找我
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for you to come.

lines.zh: 门关着也没用，我认得这扇门
lines.en: A closed door is no use; I know this door.

lines.zh: 你听见了，你的呼吸变了
lines.en: You heard it; your breathing changed.

lines.zh: 我不需要看见你，我知道你在哪
lines.en: I need not see you; I know where you are.

lines.zh: 你今晚会开那扇门
lines.en: You will open that door tonight.

lines.zh: 我慢慢移到窗边去了
lines.en: I am drifting to the window now.

lines.zh: 窗上的影子是我，别怀疑
lines.en: The shape at the window is me; do not doubt it.

lines.zh: 我一敲，你就该想了
lines.en: One knock, and you will start thinking.

lines.zh: 我不进来，我只想让你睡不着
lines.en: I will not come in; I only want you sleepless.

lines.zh: 你的名字我不必知道
lines.en: I do not need your name.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，门还在那边
lines.en: You back into the corner; the door is still there.

lines.zh: 这一夜，你逃不出这栋房子
lines.en: Tonight you do not leave this house.

lines.zh: 我站在门后，你过来就够近了
lines.en: I stand behind the door; come closer and that is close enough.

lines.zh: 我敲了第三下
lines.en: I knock a third time.

lines.zh: 我在门后站了一个时辰
lines.en: I have stood behind this door for an hour.

lines.zh: 你在里面走来走去，我跟着转
lines.en: You pace inside; I turn with you.

lines.zh: 你开门看，外面是空的
lines.en: Open it and look: nothing there.

lines.zh: 我移到窗边了，玻璃上有响
lines.en: I am at the window now; the glass taps.

lines.zh: 我不急，你总会出来
lines.en: I am patient; you must come out eventually.

lines.zh: 你把所有灯都点上了，我知道
lines.en: You lit every lamp; I know.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳，越来越快
lines.en: I count your heartbeat; it quickens.

lines.zh: 我离门口只有一寸
lines.en: I am an inch from the threshold.

lines.zh: 你听见锯子的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the sawing?

lines.zh: 我从窗缝里看你，别拉窗帘
lines.en: I watch through the gap; do not draw the curtain.

lines.zh: 你要是睡着，我就进来坐
lines.en: If you fall asleep, I will come in and sit.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊是给外面的人听的
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting is for those outside.

lines.zh: 你的影子在墙上，我的在门后
lines.en: Your shadow is on the wall; mine is behind the door.

lines.zh: 这房子只有一扇门，我记得
lines.en: This house has one door; I remember.

lines.zh: 每一步我都知道你走到哪
lines.en: I know where each of your steps lands.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我不在；你不看，我就在
lines.en: Look back and I am gone; look away and I am there.

lines.zh: 我把手从门缝里伸进来了
lines.en: I have slipped my hand through the gap.

lines.zh: 你要是叫，我就先退一步
lines.en: If you scream, I will step back one pace.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，你就会来开门
lines.en: Wait a little longer, and you will open it.

lines.zh: 我一直在，只是你没看见
lines.en: I was always here; you simply did not see me.

lines.zh: 我从门后伸手，抓住了门框
lines.en: I reach from behind the door and grip the frame.

lines.zh: 木板裂开的声音，比我快
lines.en: The wood splits faster than you.

lines.zh: 我不打你，我只要你不睡
lines.en: I do not strike you; I only keep you from sleep.

lines.zh: 我贴上来，冷得像井水
lines.en: I press close, cold as well water.

lines.zh: 你在门内，我在门外，只隔一层
lines.en: You inside, me outside, one layer between.

lines.zh: 我一碰，你的灯就灭了
lines.en: One touch from me and your lamp dies.

lines.zh: 我的手从门缝里慢慢伸出来。
lines.en: My hand slides out slowly through the door crack.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你就开始退
lines.en: I stand still, and you begin to retreat.

lines.zh: 锯子的声音贴到你耳边
lines.en: The sawing sound is at your ear.

lines.zh: 你被逼到角落，门还在我背后
lines.en: You are cornered, and the door is behind me.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，又放下
lines.en: I raise a hand, then lower it.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我很满意
lines.en: Your breath is ragged; I am pleased.

lines.zh: 我把你逼回屋里，关上门
lines.en: I herd you back inside and shut the door.

lines.zh: 我不追出这栋房子
lines.en: I do not follow beyond this house.

lines.zh: 门轴转了一下，是我在动
lines.en: The hinge turns; that is me moving.

lines.zh: 你听见我笑了吗，没有声音
lines.en: Did you hear me laugh? There was no sound.

lines.zh: 屋里的温度掉了一截
lines.en: The room's warmth drops a notch.

lines.zh: 你退到床边，我不再往前
lines.en: You back to the bed; I go no further.

lines.zh: 窗外那张脸是我的
lines.en: That face at the window is mine.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我就走
lines.en: When dawn comes, I leave.

lines.zh: 有木门的地方，我就会出现
lines.en: Where there is a wooden door, I appear.

lines.zh: 门后先有影子，然后才是我
lines.en: First a shape behind the door, then me.

lines.zh: 锯子的声音先到，人后到
lines.en: The sawing arrives first, the figure after.

lines.zh: 这栋房子有门，就够了
lines.en: This house has a door; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我站在门框里，不进也不出
lines.en: I stand in the doorframe, neither in nor out.

lines.zh: 你的门是新做的，木头还湿
lines.en: Your door is new; the wood is still damp.

lines.zh: 我选中了这扇门
lines.en: I have chosen this door.

lines.zh: 屋里有人，我能感觉到
lines.en: Someone is inside; I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我从窗户那边先看了一眼
lines.en: I looked in through the window first.

lines.zh: 门缝下的光被挡住了
lines.en: The light under the door is blocked.

lines.zh: 夜刚开始，我来得正好
lines.en: The night is young; I came at the right time.

lines.zh: 我贴着门板，等屋里安静
lines.en: I press to the door and wait for the house to quiet.

lines.zh: 门把手轻轻动了一下
lines.en: The handle shifts, just slightly.

lines.zh: 我来了，别唱歌
lines.en: I am here; do not sing.

lines.zh: 火烧到门框，我退进了黑里
lines.en: Fire catches the doorframe and I sink into the dark.

lines.zh: 我从窗边掉下去，落地没声
lines.en: I fall from the window and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 水灌进我嘴里，我吐出一口黑
lines.en: Water pours into my mouth; I spit out something black.

lines.zh: 气浪把门整个吹开，我笑了
lines.en: The blast blows the door wide, and I smile.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我，钉在门板上
lines.en: An arrow passes through me and sticks in the door.

lines.zh: 这股力量照到我，我退到门后
lines.en: That force shines on me; I retreat behind the door.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只等着
lines.en: I do not eat; I only wait.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮屋子，我缩了一下
lines.en: The lightning lights the room; I flinch.

lines.zh: 门没了，脚下也没了
lines.en: No door left, and no ground either.
